resources.string: Step 1 is not done: the game code is not on this device. It is made from your own discs.\nOn your PC, run setup\\setup.cmd -Game aw (on Linux: bash setup/setup.sh --game aw) with this device connected over USB.

The game code on this device does not match this version of the app: %1$s.\n\nBuild it again: on your PC, update the project folder (git pull) and run setup\\setup.cmd -Game aw -GameOnly with this device connected over USB. Your game files and saves are kept.
Game disc found:\n%1$s\nInstall & Play plays from it where it is, and from the install disc\'s image beside it or chosen next: nothing is copied.

This game has two discs, the game disc and the install disc, and needs both. Point this at their images (.iso), on this device or its memory card: tap one and the other is found beside it, choose the folder both are in, or select both in the Files app. The game plays from the images where they are, with nothing copied; or both can be copied into the app, about 12 GB.
Nothing is copied and it is ready in a second. Both images have to stay where they are: the game reads its files out of them. Saves, settings and mods are kept in the app as always.
About 7 GB from the game disc and 4 GB from the install disc, on the device\'s own storage; a minute or two each. The images are not needed afterwards.
The game is set up to play from the two disc images. Keep both where they are.
Opens the install screen: play from the two disc images instead of the copied files (and free their 12 GB), copy the files in instead, or point at an image that has moved.

1. BUILD THE GAME CODE (%1$s): on this device, with no PC: choose \"Build the game code\" and your game disc\'s image (.iso); it took about 13 minutes on a Snapdragon 865. Or on a PC: run %3$s with this device connected over USB.\n2. INSTALL & PLAY (%2$s): plays from your two disc images (.iso), the game disc and the install disc, where they lie, also on an SD card; or copies them into the app, about 12 GB.

The game code is made from your own copy of the game, here on this device. It needs your game disc\'s image (.iso), which is only read, the toolchain package (the compiler, installed once, a download of about 45 MB) and about 1 GB of free space while it works. The build took about 13 minutes on a Retroid Pocket Flip 2 (Snapdragon 865), the one device it was measured on, and takes longer on a slower or hot one; it carries on while you use other apps, and from where it was if it is interrupted.
